instruction: Residential Block Model This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio residential block model and save the required output as result.osm. 1. The output folder contains result.osm with size at least 500 bytes. 2. Result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10. 3. Result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:BuildingStory, 6 OS:Space objects, and 6 OS:ThermalZone objects. 4. The OS:Space names are exactly Unit-1, Unit-2, Unit-3, Unit-4, Corridor, and Stair. 5. Every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2. 6. The model has exactly 41 OS:Surface objects: 6 Floor surfaces, 6 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 29 Wall surfaces. 7. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 6 Ground, 17 Outdoors, and 18 Surface. 8. The model has exactly 0 OS:SubSurface objects. 9. The model contains exactly 0 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 6 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, and 0 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects. 10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 24.00 m, Y span 10.00 m, and Z span 3.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m. 11. The sum of floor surface areas is 200.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 217.60 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
